audio-analyzer.description: Rust-based audio analysis: spectral features, key detection, BPM, LUFS, stereo width, dynamics, section boundaries. Faster than Python FFT.

agent-mem0.description: Persistent cross-session memory. Stores production decisions, EQ choices, what worked and what didn't. LLM: gemini-2.0-flash. Embedder: gemini-embedding-001. Key loaded from .env
